items.title: Arizona Natural Gas Cash Plunges $4 as West Cools, Heat Shifts East
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices fell at most hubs Friday for delivery through Monday as cooler weather unwound the Desert Southwest’s late-week price spike, while the eastward-shifting heat dome lifted Louisiana and Southeast hubs.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Ease as October Takes Prompt Baton
items.summary: Natural gas futures pulled back Friday as cooler early September weather trends undercut demand expectations and Thursday’s rally stalled short of $3, outweighing persistent late-summer heat and the leanest storage builds of the summer.

items.title: Intense Heat Propels Mexico’s Natural Gas Imports
items.summary: Mexico’s natural gas imports from the United States averaged over 8 Bcf/d since Monday as scorching temperatures in the northern part of the country drove cooling demand.

items.title: Commercialization Seen as ‘Key Hurdle’ for Ksi Lisims LNG Project in Canada
items.summary: Rapidan Energy’s Global Gas Service expects the second 14 Mt/y phase of LNG Canada to be sanctioned early next year, but the firm said the timeline for other projects planned for North America’s west coast in Canada and Mexico is less clear.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Slip as Shoulder Season Looms
items.summary: Natural gas futures remained lower around midday Friday as traders weighed the approaching shoulder season decline in demand against strong LNG feedgas and hotter regional changes to the weather outlook. Physical prices, meanwhile, were mixed.

items.title: South Central Natural Gas Storage Shrinks as Strong Demand Dictates Withdrawal
items.summary: Operators in the South Central region drew heavily on supply in storage during the week ended Aug. 21 as sweltering heat and recovering LNG activity put upward pressure on demand.

items.title: Transco, Florida Natural Gas Basis Strengthens as Pipelines Near Capacity
items.summary: September natural gas basis across the Southeast has strengthened sharply relative to October as lingering cooling demand keeps pressure on pipeline systems already running near capacity.

items.title: Fall Natural Gas Storage Builds Seen Lagging Norms Despite High Output
items.summary: Near-record US natural gas production should allow storage injections to accelerate as summer demand fades, but growing LNG demand could keep fall builds below historical norms and inventories shy of 4 Tcf heading into winter.

items.title: LNG Incumbents Seen Leading Next Wave of North American FIDs in 2027
items.summary: A tight global natural gas market driven by lingering conflict in Iran is likely to sustain commercial momentum for new North American LNG capacity working to move ahead, according to Rapidan Energy.

items.title: Amazon Nears 1 GW of Wind Power in Sweden With Four New Deals
items.summary: Amazon has expanded Germany’s largest-ever power purchase agreement (PPA), signed in June, and announced another four deals to buy power from four wind farms in Sweden as the e-commerce giant and other electricity-intensive hyperscalers look to power
